records.title: Garnier en-ZA Banana shampoo page — version identity (350 ml, ZA)
records.claim: The official Garnier South Africa en-ZA page names this exact version as Ultimate Blends Hair Food Nourishing Banana Hair Food Shampoo For Dry Hair, 350 ml, for the ZA market.
records.limitations: Web-only: front label unseen, no barcode; packaging is authoritative for identity; marketing benefit wording is excluded from support.

records.title: Garnier en-ZA Banana shampoo page — manufacturer directions

records.limitations: Web-only: front label unseen, no barcode; directions describe use and do not establish comparative efficacy; packaging is authoritative; marketing benefit wording is excluded from support.
